# Ziro Market

> Ziro Market publishes clear, data-backed explainers and news on the Indian stock market, crypto, IPOs, and global macro for retail investors. Every article leads with a direct answer, cites specific numbers, and is written to be quoted. This is general information, not investment advice.

Site: https://ziromarket.com
Blog: https://ziromarket.com/blog

## Markets and macro
- [Stock market this month: what to watch](https://ziromarket.com/blog/stock-market-august-2026-what-to-watch): forward monthly outlook of the events that will move the Nifty and Sensex.
- [Indian stock market today](https://ziromarket.com/blog/indian-stock-market-today): the daily Nifty and Sensex wrap with the reasons behind the move.
- [RBI rate decision, August 2026](https://ziromarket.com/blog/rbi-mpc-august-2026-preview): the RBI held the repo rate at 5.25% with a neutral stance.
- [US Fed decision and its impact on India](https://ziromarket.com/blog/us-fed-decision-july-2026-india-impact): how the Fed's move drives the rupee and foreign flows.
- [De-dollarization in 2026](https://ziromarket.com/blog/de-dollarization-brics-2026-dollar-dominance): the dollar still holds 59% of reserves but BRICS, gold and CIPS are gaining.
- [Why central banks are buying gold](https://ziromarket.com/blog/central-banks-buying-gold-2026): record central-bank gold buying near 1,000 tonnes a year and why.
